title: Merge-up / conflict chain (tmux, fake forge, level a): a clean tool merge-up after review pins all four SHAs (B, H, updated base, updated head), and identical content plus green CI carries the passing verdict from H with no new round; the owner's merge-ok at H does not carry to the updated head of a crew:sensitive change; whitespace, path or mode changes and an unavailable B never carry; a train over three PRs editing one shared line keeps the clean member, whose step patch is identical, and drops the two conflicts; train close routes both to builders with no update-branch and no synthesizer edit to a PR head; each builder merges main, resolves the conflict and records the four SHAs in a signed fix note; the differing patch blocks carry until a delta re-review posts a new head-pinned verdict; a verdict without base drops as no-verified-base and routes to the reviewer
